references.text: The law's regulation concerning the sin offering with a male goat for unintentional sin, showing the background for using a male goat as a sin offering.
On the Day of Atonement, a male goat was sacrificed as a sin offering to make atonement for the people, the same purpose as in Num 28:22.
A male goat is used as a sin offering to make atonement for the entire congregation.
Parallel text about the male goat as a sin offering at the New Moon festival, with the same wording regarding atonement.
Similar regulation concerning the sin offering with a male goat to make atonement, during the Feast of Tabernacles.
King Hezekiah's restoration of temple worship included sin offerings with male goats to make atonement for all Israel.
Christ as the final atonement, in contrast to the blood of goats and calves, shows how the Old Testament sacrificial system pointed forward to his perfect sacrifice.
